BrochureContent.Content:
O'Donnellan & Joyce Auctioneers are delighted to offer to market a four bed detached in the popular city location of The Green, College Road in the heart of Galway City.The Green is one of Galway City's most sought after developments with an abundance of amenities & services right on your doorstep.Perfectly positioned off College Road adjacent to the new Dexcom Stadium, the property is a 5 minute walk from Eyre Square and the main train and bus stations.

Several college campuses such as Yeats College, University of Galway & ATU College all easily accessible either on foot or via the excellent transport network. 

No 54 The Green has been modernised in recent years and a new BER Cert & rating is pending. 

The property is presented in turnkey condition ready for immediate ocucpancy.
The ground accommodation is comprised of an entrance hall, living room with feature bay window and open fireplace, double doors lead into the open plan kitchen and dining room that overlooks the rear garden. 

A ground floor WC and utility room with rear door access completes the ground floor. 

Upstairs contains a main bathroom and four bedrooms with the master bedroom ensuite. The other three bedrooms all contain sink units. A Stira stair provides access to the attic with ample storage.
Externally the property benefits from ample off-street parking for multiple cars, whilst the rear backs onto the Dexcom Stadium and contains a large private garden with boiler shed.

The Green is well serviced by several shopping centres & retails parks, as well as having quick access to several business parks & multi-nationals such as Parkmore, Creganna, Medtronic & Boston Scientific.

Additionally, the area is excellently serviced by quality transport links giving easy access to Galway City Centre, neighbouring suburbs, as well as the M6 & M18 motorways.

No 54 The Green is an ideal property for all buyers, whether owner occupants or investment, due to the excellent location, quality condition & proximity to all that Galway City has on offer.

Viewing is highly recommended and guaranteed not to disappoint.
